visual.general_description: Grouped bar chart of the percent of hoverboard injuries by injury type for pediatric (Peds) and adult patients.
visual.detailed_description: Bar chart with five categories on the x-axis: Fracture, Contusion, Concussion, Sprain and Laceration/Abrasion. Each category has a black Peds bar on the left and a grey Adults bar on the right, with printed labels: Fracture 46.2% (Peds) and 27.3% (Adults); Contusion 30.8% and 43.2%; Concussion 17.9% and 20.5%; Sprain 10.3% and 20.5%; Laceration/Abrasion 2.6% and 6.8%. The y-axis runs 0% to 100% in steps of 10% with no axis title. A legend (Peds, Adults) sits below the plot, with the printed note "Note: Represented differences are not statistically significant". No panel letters or patient identifiers.
